_doc: Hands-free turn and barge-in on the Plus profile with the voice front end modelled (estimates). Targets: architecture v1.0 §9.4.

afe.wakes.why: one wake word in the script

ai.wakes.why: the wake word started exactly one turn

ai.barge_ins.why: speaking over the answer interrupted it once

ai.answers.why: the interrupted answer never completes; the second one does

hub.requests.ai.listen.why: privacy: only the wake word and the interruption start an upload, nothing before

ai.barge_to_stop_ms.max.why: the person starts talking -> the answer stops (architecture §9.4: <= 200 ms)
